subject.title: Feature: Surface cron job name / session label in /status and statusline

question: Should CLI/TUI status surfaces make `label`/`displayName` the primary session identifier, and what raw-key fallback plus terminal-sanitization contract should be required?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the permanent display precedence, raw-key visibility, and untrusted-text handling are product/UX choices before another fix lane should start.

options.title: Adopt narrow sanitized display contract
options.body: Make friendly labels primary in status surfaces, sanitize terminal output, and keep raw session keys available as fallback or detail.

options.title: Keep raw keys primary
options.body: Preserve current resolvable raw-key output and close or narrow the request to picker-only behavior.

options.title: Defer to attribution redesign
options.body: Fold the work into the broader stable attribution-fields discussion instead of changing human-readable status output now.

recommendation.title: Adopt narrow sanitized display contract
recommendation.body: Make friendly labels primary in status surfaces, sanitize terminal output, and keep raw session keys available as fallback or detail.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current-history connection to the shared status and TUI `/status` paths that would own the display contract.
